summary: Prepare an isolated iOS test app and independent XCUITest observation target through the existing daily delivery lane

compatibility.detail: Normal delivery remains the default with its existing identifiers and state path. The opt-in test variant uses a separate app, keychain entitlement, app group and delivery state namespace.

downtime.detail: No normal-app replacement or pairing migration.

manual.detail: Before the first signed device build of the test variant, Johannes registers and provisions the test app com.compoundingtech.fractal.test and the XCUITest runner com.compoundingtech.fractal.test.xctrunner (app group, keychain group, both profiles). Initial pairing and enrollment need their own consent; this change does neither. The normal app needs no action.

recovery.detail: Normal delivery state is not migrated. Test artifacts and delivery state are scoped under ios-test-variant.
